meta.description: Headlines a reviewer has handled for a brief. scripts/news/build_brief_news_queue.py leaves these out of the brief's news queue (data/alerts/brief-news-queue.json), so a story drops off once it has been dealt with. status 'used': the brief was updated from the article, with its quote in _verified/. status 'dismissed': not relevant to the brief, with the reason. Match is by link, or by headline when the link changed.
